name: Daylight Factor Heatmap
summary: Computes the Daylight Factor of the selected zones with Radiance, checks it against EN 17037, draws a heatmap in each zone and exports to Excel or CSV.

versions.changelog: Place heatmaps: a GDL heatmap object per zone draws each cell in its colour on the floor plan, with a label and a legend, optionally in 3D; placing again updates it.
First version: Daylight Factor per zone under a CIE overcast sky with Radiance, statistics against a target, zones coloured by average DF, Excel and CSV export.
